quote: they do not anticipate any different experiences
content: The essay gives the rule, in the bowling-ball paragraph that Fable skips. Beliefs about unobservables are legitimate when they "have an inferential consequence that is a direct sensory anticipation." The floor and the 9.8 m/s² pay rent through what they let you predict. Phlogiston, on the essay's account, was linked to experience only "after the experience." That is not the positivists' criterion of meaning for single sentences, which Hempel showed could not be stated. It is a test on networks of belief: does conditioning on the belief change what you expect? That is also how Bayesian confirmation theory handles theoretical terms. The rule is realism for beliefs that sharpen predictions and suspicion for beliefs that do not, and the essay states it.

quote: this belief yielded no advance predictions
content: Grant that phlogiston had predictive content in its best years. The essay's charge is about how it was used: "the link from phlogiston to experience was always configured after the experience." The chief witness on that is Lavoisier. In 1785 he complained that chemists had made phlogiston "a vague principle... which consequently adapts itself to all the explanations for which it may be required," sometimes with weight and sometimes without, "a veritable Proteus that changes its form every instant" ("Réflexions sur le phlogistique," no DOI). When calxes turned out heavier than their metals, some defenders gave phlogiston negative weight rather than count a failed prediction. Chang argues the theory was dropped too early (Chang 2012), but that is a claim about what it might have become, not about how its defenders used it.

quote: It is a uniquely human flaw among animal species
content: Skinner's pigeons are not a counterexample, even on the reinterpretation the note cites. Staddon and Simmelhag showed that the rituals were interim and terminal behaviors driven by the feeding schedule itself (Staddon & Simmelhag 1971). On either reading, the pigeon's behavior is tied to an experience, the arrival of food, and misreads it. That is a wrong anticipation, a false belief of the proper kind. A floating belief in the essay's sense is a node connected to other nodes and to no experience, like "post-utopian" linked to "colonial alienation," and it needs propositional networks that pigeons do not have. The note also calls the flaw "the direct cost of that strength," and the essay says the same thing: "a perversion of Homo sapiens's ability to build more general and flexible belief networks."

quote: what would definitely falsify this belief?
content: Fable's own history shows why the question gets a null answer. When Wöhler made urea from inorganic materials, the vitalists did not give up; they redrew the line. By Fable's account the doctrine "died slowly" over seventy-five years, absorbing results one at a time (Ramberg 2000). A theory that absorbs each apparent refutation by moving its boundary does not prohibit anything in the sense the essay asks about. Driesch described his entelechy as non-spatial and not a form of energy, which is to say it was built so that it could not be measured. The regulating embryos were an observation that entelechy was invented to name, not a prediction on which it staked anything.

quote: If a belief turns deadbeat, evict it.
content: Le Verrier's move is the rent being paid. The unseen planet came with a predicted position, and Galle found Neptune within a degree of it on the first night he looked. When Le Verrier tried the same move on Mercury's perihelion and predicted Vulcan, no planet appeared, and Vulcan was evicted. The dragon that is permeable to flour predicts nothing and is never at risk. Duhem and Quine are right that a failed prediction does not identify the guilty conjunct. The Bayesian answer is to distribute the blame by prior probability, and it shows why Newtonian gravity rightly survived Uranus (Dorling 1979, Studies in History and Philosophy of Science; Strevens 2001). The slogan does not tell you which belief to evict. It tells you to evict the one that stops paying, and the Vulcan episode is the slogan working.

quote: so you can regurgitate it on the upcoming quiz
content: Hestenes's students extend the essay's thesis; they do not refute it. "F = ma" held as a token for the exam, connected to other tokens and to no anticipation, is a floating belief exactly as the essay defines one (Hestenes, Wells & Swackhamer 1992). The sequence applies the same diagnosis to physics teaching two essays later, in Guessing the Teacher's Password, using the wave equation and the diffusion equation as its examples. An invented author makes the cleanest illustration because nothing about him can be checked, and that is the point being illustrated.
